name: dk_retrieval_benchmark
description:
Retsinformation retrieval benchmark
	

Datasets related to generating a Q & Chunk dataset based on guides  (vejledninger) from retsinformation.dk to be used as a retrieval benchmark.
vejledninger_tekst.csv contains a dict with all vejledninger (scraped 8/11/23) from retsinformation.dk 
chunks_id_text.csv contains text chunks of max 512 token len, based on splitting all the text from vejledninger_tekst.csv, along with a unique id
chunks_questions_100_samples.csv contains a sample of 200… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/jealk/dk_retrieval_benchmark.
evaluation_method: Recall@k, MRR (mean reciprocal rank), and exact_match for QA answers
reputation: A niche, community dataset on Hugging Face providing Danish legal guidance text for retrieval research; modest adoption in domain-specific retrieval work.
